text:
The wind

beats swords of ice.


-I will not open the window-


The wind

decapitates stars.


-I will not open the window-


The wind

carries tongues of fire.


-I will not open the window-


In telegrams of shadow

that the winds keep carrying,

the Great News can already be read,

the news that shakes the Universe...


-I will not open my window-

translation.title: The Wind...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated refusal to open the window against apocalyptic wind.
